body.statement: Can one construct the ranked fixing-overlap saturation specified by the handle using only \(\mathsf{Ops}\), with every reachable state satisfying its guard-cover, local-value preservation, exact unresolved-pair, and no-lost-disagreement invariant, and with every terminal state encoded either as a guarded circuit whose overlapping satisfied branches have one common \(\operatorname{Eval}\) value or as the fully checked tuple \((G_1,G_2,M_1,M_2,p,c_x,c_y)\) of a bounded collision certificate? The construction must terminate and return the circuit exactly when \(\phi_{G_1}=\phi_{G_2}\) on every nonempty \(\Omega_{G_1}\cap\Omega_{G_2}\). A further quantitative objective is to make its state count, bit complexity, and encoded terminal output at most \(B_{\mathrm{out}}(\ell)\); this \(E_4\) bound is conditional on supplying such a decreasing-rank construction and size analysis.
body.justification: This constructive normal form is the sole non-routine bridge from semantic finite-union identification to a graph-native algorithm.
body.gap: YvernesEtAl2026DerivationGraphs gives a four-step normal form for single conditional-interventional kernels in one ADMG and explicitly leaves finite representations for full ID expressions open; LeeSpekkens2017AlgebraicCausal supplies general elimination only for tiny finite functional structures.
body.consumer: Solving it supplies the terminating compilation or separating-pair step required by Global-CID without relabelling unrestricted real quantifier elimination as causal identification.
